catalog_coordinate_system: ICRS, original event and detection epochs kept separately
limitations: All instrument-passing real and control triggers use the same bounded cone and same-observation catalog join. The circular positional envelope is a review aid, not a false-association probability. Each association and its CSC quality flags are retained. Weak or forced CSC per-observation photometry is possible. Positional overlap and a catalog variability index are evidence about prior measurement, not the physical origin or burst epoch. Empty master or observation rows can reflect catalog coverage, sensitivity or confusion.
